notes.title: Jump Heroes is coming soon!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello Heroes! [/h2][/b]

We are excited to announce the release of our game Jump Heroes on PC soon! Although we released it on mobile at the end of 2023, we didn't have plans to stop developing it! 

[b][h2]What to expect?[/h2][/b]

Our newest feature on PC release is going to be a local Co-Op. We had tons of fun during development, so we hope you will love it as much as we do! So how does it work? In Co-Op mode, or more accurately - PvP, play against your friends and compete for the highest scores! Just plug in a controller and show everybody who's the boss! If you don't have one, no worries, you can still enjoy it while one of you will control the hero by WSAD, and the other will play on arrows! Such a versatility, huh? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44919071/939bdef66d6e1f69a0742a2d87b67db0da950e8c.png[/img]

[b][h2]A few words about![/h2]
[/b]
Jump Heroes is the first game of ours as Radikate. We believe you'll enjoy it, and Jump Heroes becomes the good choice for quick sessions in this world in a rush! Unlock new heroes, jump over and over, and climb to the top in leaderboards! That's what Jump Heroes is about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44919071/bc1d8a9f9b4ef9543b901ae3f7a67a112397fe38.png[/img]

If you want to keep Jump Heroes always by your side, download it now on iOS & Android! 

[b][h2]Follow us![/h2][/b]

Don't forget to join our community on Discord and be the first to know what's about in our studio!

[url=https://discord.gg/xjfbSJgesf][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44919071/f8e83e4c7d3d5afee651f9ece36f983412135727.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44919071/f45d6713976113a8504e6f6ab1b0ee5a50846b86.png[/img][/url][/url]

[b]We wish you highscores only!
Radikate team[/b]
